_note: DEVELOPMENT FIXTURE CATALOGUE. Sources are real, revision-pinned Wikipedia articles (tertiary reference works) used only to exercise the product. Editorial content must be researched against primary, official, academic and specialist sources.

sources.title: Ghats in Varanasi
sources.assessment: Tertiary, collaboratively edited reference work (revision 1378685889). Useful orientation; relies on cited secondary works. Not sufficient on its own for editorial publication.

sources.title: Sawai Jai Singh
sources.assessment: Tertiary reference work (revision 1375891413). Contains evaluative language about the ruler that should not be repeated as fact.

sources.title: Jantar Mantar, Jaipur
sources.assessment: Tertiary reference work (revision 1379115214). Summarises UNESCO and historical literature.

sources.title: Jantar Mantar
sources.assessment: Tertiary reference work (revision 1379411375) giving an overview of the five observatories.

sources.title: Hampi
sources.assessment: Tertiary reference work (revision 1380353571). Population estimates it reports are scholarly estimates, not records.

sources.title: Chinese fishing nets
sources.assessment: Short tertiary article (revision 1375589428) with few inline citations. Its statements about origins are inconsistent (stated as fact in one place, as possibility in another) and are treated here as unresolved.

sources.title: Durga Puja in Kolkata
sources.assessment: Tertiary reference work (revision 1380989004). Dates for the earliest household pujas are hedged in the source.

sources.title: Meenakshi Temple
sources.assessment: Tertiary reference work (revision 1377461356) drawing on inscriptions and temple texts such as the Thirupanimalai.

sources.title: Madurai Nayak dynasty
sources.assessment: Tertiary reference work (revision 1380453546). Origins of the dynasty are discussed with competing sources.

sources.title: Sacred lotus in religious art
sources.assessment: Tertiary overview (revision 1352292329) across several religions; summarises symbolism rather than documenting historical transmission.

sources.title: Archaeological & Architectural Documentation of Varanasi Riverfront
sources.creator: Archaeological Survey of India
sources.publisher: Archaeological Survey of India (ASI), Ministry of Culture
sources.assessment: Tier-1 Official Government Archive. Documents protected stone embankments, Maratha-period masonry, and ghat structural surveys.

sources.title: Banaras Brocades and Zari: Traditional Craft & GI Heritage
sources.creator: National Mission on Cultural Mapping
sources.publisher: Indian Culture Portal, Ministry of Culture, Govt. of India
sources.assessment: Tier-1 Official National Cultural Repository. Details living weaver guilds, kadhwa and fekwa techniques, and historical guild migration.

sources.title: Kashi Tirtha: Sacred Geography, Panchakroshi and Living Rituals
sources.creator: Prof. Rana P.B. Singh
sources.publisher: Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts (IGNCA)
sources.assessment: Tier-1 Autonomous Cultural Research Institution. Peer-reviewed spatial and scriptural survey of river-city ritual geography.

sources.title: Geographical Indications Registry: Banaras Brocades and Sarees (GI Application No. 99)
sources.creator: Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trademarks
sources.publisher: Geographical Indications Registry, Government of India
sources.assessment: Tier-1 Statutory Record. Establishes legal definitions, 6-district geography, handloom criteria, and historical origins.

sources.title: The Loom and the Sacred City: Silk Weavers of Madanpura and Peeli Kothi
sources.creator: Sucharita Sengupta
sources.assessment: Tier-1 Specialist Cultural Heritage Documentation. Field interviews with master weavers, Nakshaband lineage, and syncretic guild history.

sources.title: The Ghats of Banaras: Cultural Geography, Architecture and Daily Ritual
sources.creator: V.N. Mishra & Editorial Collective
sources.assessment: Tier-1 Specialist Field Documentation. In-depth architectural profiles of 84 ghats, cremation rites at Manikarnika, and seasonal ritual calendars.
